title: Dum Adventure
description: Modpack made for Dum SMP, an survival plus with adventure and guns
body:
# Simple Modpack For Permabaran Absurd With Guns

_Author : Sorry for bad english, I will use AI translator for this description. I am not natively speak and/or writing by english language, still learning_

## **English (MTL)**

This modpack serves as the foundational modpack for all projects under the DumAdventure private server. I decided to create this base modpack to streamline the development process for the Private Server, especially since I've also been assigned to manage the Back-End aspects of the Server Hosting. And thus, this was created.

However, this journey has only just begun, as I've only prepared the alpha stage of this modpack. For future progress, I'll consider it when I have both the time and energy.
This modpack includes the standard mods I typically use, along with optimizations for both the client (still in progress) and server. Additionally, custom recipes and datapacks will be provided, but not at this time.

The content in this base modpack offers an 'Easy Survival' experience with a slight twist—almost akin to Vanilla++. However, what sets this modpack apart from typical Vanilla++ is the inclusion of firearms. I chose [Timeless And Classic Guns : Zero](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) since I’ve grown accustomed to using it since my days playing on version [1.16.5](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-guns).

I’ve also frequently encountered issues with game progression being either too fast or too slow. To address this, I integrated [Pufferfish's Skill Tree](https://modrinth.com/mod/skills) (though it’s not fully configured by default) to introduce essential survival attributes. Additionally, mods like [Sophisticated Backpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks), [Tool Belt](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tool-belt), [Parcool](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool) & [Paraglider](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/paragliders), dan [Legendary Survival Overhaul](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/legendary-survival-overhaul) enhance the experience, making it far more engaging than standard Vanilla gameplay.

## **Bahasa Indonesia**
Modpack ini merupakan basis modpack untuk segala project dari DumAdventure private server, saya terpikir untuk membuat basis modpack agar mempercepat proses pembuatan untuk Server Privat terlebih saya juga ditugaskan untuk mengurusi bagian Back-End dari Hosting Server. Dan begitulah ini tercipta.

Akan tetapi jalan ini baru dimulai karena saya hanya menyediakan tahap alpha dari modpack ini, untuk progress selanjutnya akan aku pikirkan jika ada waktu dan tenaga.
Di dalam modpack ini terdapat mod standart yang saya gunakan, sekaligus optimasi sisi client (masih progress) dan server. Selain itu Custom Recipe dan Datapack juga akan saya sediakan tapi bukan untuk sekarang.

Untuk konten didalam Basis modpack menyajikan pengalaman "Easy Survival" tapi dengan sedikit sentuhan, malah mirip dengan Vanilla++. Tapi yang membedakan modpack ini dengan Vanilla++ ada pada Senjata Api yang digunakan. [Timeless And Classic Guns : Zero](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) dipilih mengingat saya sudah terbiasa menggunakannya sejak bermain di versi [1.16.5](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-guns). Saya juga sering bermasalah pada progres permainan yang acapkali terlalu cepat atau terlalu lambat jadi untuk mengakalinya saya gunakan [Pufferfish's Skill Tree](https://modrinth.com/mod/skills) (Secara default belum dibuat) untuk menambahkan Attribute yang penting saat Survival. Terdapat juga [Sophisticated Backpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks), [Tool Belt](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tool-belt), [Parcool](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool) & [Paraglider](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/paragliders), dan [Legendary Survival Overhaul](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/legendary-survival-overhaul) yang menambah keseruan daripada bermain metah secara Vanilla.
